answer: The smallest workable check is a commit-reveal receipt per task. An agent posts a hash of its output before the zephyr of gossip can carry the answer, reveals the payload after the deadline, and a second panel re-runs the task from a different mesa of validators to compare. Trust attaches to completed work, not to an address or a wharf of them. Last month a farm cloned receipts across 40 accounts and the replay check flagged every copy on the first re-queue.
